Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Company Description Avacone Romania supports organizations operating in complex and regulated and non-regulated environments through strategic consulting, disciplined execution, and transformation leadership. Combining technical depth, market insight, and operational precision, the company delivers measurable and sustainable impact across critical business functions. As part of the international Avacone group, Avacone Romania works with structured delivery models and reliable expertise to provide long-term value. Core focus areas include strategic transformation for IT and infrastructure. The team operates where clarity, trust, and high-quality execution are essential for client success.
 Role Description The Servicedesk Engineer with German will provide first-line technical support to end users, focusing on incident logging, troubleshooting, and resolution for IT and infrastructure-related issues. Day-to-day responsibilities include answering and documenting service requests, diagnosing hardware and software problems, escalating complex issues to higher-level support, and following established IT service management processes. The role involves using ticketing systems, maintaining knowledge base entries, and ensuring timely communication with users in both German and English. The Servicedesk Engineer will collaborate closely with internal IT teams and external stakeholders to uphold service quality and meet SLAs. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Cluj, Romania.
 Qualifications 
Strong technical support skills in areas such as Windows operating systems, basic networking, user account management, and standard office applications. Azure-Intune, Active Directory, Microsoft O365 pack.
Experience working with IT service management tools (e.g., ticketing systems ServiceNow), incident and request handling, and structured troubleshooting methodologies.
Proficient German language skills (spoken and written) and good command of English to support international clients and internal teams.
Customer service and communication abilities, including clear documentation, active listening, and a professional, solution-oriented approach.
Organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, follow procedures, and meet agreed service levels.
Relevant education in IT, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in a service desk or helpdesk environment.
Familiarity with regulated or complex environments and an understanding of confidentiality, compliance, and data protection requirements is an advantage.
Willingness to learn, adapt to new technologies, and collaborate in a diverse, international team environment.
